_template_notes.purpose: Frontend Component graph — Discovery Plugin #7 (v2.0 Gói C++). Parse React/Next.js components + props signatures + import dependencies. Source: Glob `apps/erp-web/components/**/*.tsx` + AST props extraction. Consumed by lane CD11 (FE Component Contracts) qua graph_dependency.
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per component file — {id, name, module, file_path, props[], default_export, named_exports[], fingerprint}
props[]: 1 entry per prop — {name, type, required, default_value, jsdoc_description}
edges[]: 1 entry per import relation — {from_component, to_component, import_kind: 'default|named|namespace', is_internal: true|false}
metadata.build_at: ISO 8601 timestamp khi graph built
metadata.scope_root: 'apps/erp-web/components' (v2.0 chỉ scan erp-web — mobile defer v2.1)
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' nếu fallback Grep, '2.0' nếu ts-morph/tsc AST (TODO v2.1)
metadata.skipped_files[]: files với parse error (log fail không block)
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/erp-web/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (per CD11 graph_dependency optional)
Tech stack frontend != Next.js → SKIP, log E137 WARN (parser chỉ support Next.js conventions)
